title: Classic · concert grands
blurb: The nine-foot instruments that fill a hall: the reference grands of Steinway, Bösendorfer, Fazioli, Yamaha, Kawai, Bechstein, Blüthner and Mason & Hamlin.

items.d: 1884 · Steinway & Sons — the 8 ft 11 in concert grand that became the reference of the recital hall.
1900s · Bösendorfer — 9 ft 6 in and 97 keys; the extra bass octave is the Viennese signature.
2000s · Fazioli — 10 ft 2 in, the longest production concert grand, built in Sacile.
2010 · Yamaha — the 9 ft flagship that took a Japanese concert grand to the Chopin Competition final.
2000s · Kawai — 9 ft with carbon-composite action parts, hand-built in the Shigeru workshop.
9 ft 3 in · C. Bechstein — Berlin's concert grand, voiced for a rounder, darker fortissimo.
9 ft 2 in · Blüthner — the Leipzig grand with aliquot stringing, a fourth string in the treble.
9 ft 4 in · Mason & Hamlin — the American concert grand with the tension resonator under the board.
